comments.text: Interesting side note for those who are of the Christian fault and study the Bible. In the Hebrew text, the lands of central Asia we now know as the nations of Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan etc are called the lands of Magog, Meshech and Tubal. In the final years, someone of Ishmaelite (Saudi or Jordanese) descent will come from these lands who will rule over an global political system containing Central Asia, most of Europe, the Middle East and north Africa. Just sharing for those that may find it I testing and want to delve deeper into the originating text.
